run_scitail_preprocessing: run the scitail dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_scitail_dataset: create a SciTail classification dataset instance that loads the scitail SNLI format from HuggingFace
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace scitail dataset split to a list of sentence pairs with entailment labels
load_scitail_dataset: load the scitail dataset in SNLI format using the HuggingFace datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the scitail dataset using a specified random seed
